entries.title: Short UNG through the fourth quarter
entries.cell: instrument_translation x energy (October first-session close, h63)
entries.trigger: SPY closes more than 2% below its 52w closing high (below 760.43) by the 10/06 close. Entry offsets +1 to +3 sessions hold +14% to +16% overall, and the off-high branch is 11-0 at +23.3% against a near-high branch with no excess (+4.21% 5-3 vs +5.51% drift). If it fires, size off at least 6 ATR, time-only: any stop up to 3 ATR guts the result (2018 adverse move 26.9 ATR).

entries.title: Long a P&C insurer basket into the end of cat season
entries.cell: rank_outlier x us_large (TRV CB HIG AIG ALL PGR SIGI RLI, h21)
entries.trigger: SPY closes below 760.43 (2% under its 52w high) by the 10/08 close, AND a fresh test shows the October off-high basket minus XLF beating the generic off-high insurer drift (+0.73% per month, 131-91), where October ranked only 4th of 12. Without the second condition the branch flip alone does not make it a seasonal.

entries.title: Long XLF against SPY for the fourth quarter from a near-high start
entries.cell: rank_outlier x us_large (XLF-SPY, near-high branch, h63)
entries.trigger: Only a stated mechanism plus robustness revives it: the near-high 10-1 (p 0.006, +2.82%) holds at exactly h63 but is 7-4 at h42 and 6-4 with the start moved 3 sessions. Revive if a pre-specified re-test shows h42 and h84 both at 8-3 or better from a fixed October entry.
